% DRIFT formal specification -- binding occupancy (Hill equation).
%
% The source of truth is DRIFT's code:
%   drift/binding.py :: BindingEngine.calculate_occupancy
%       numerator   = drug_concentration ** hill_coefficient
%       denominator = numerator + kd ** hill_coefficient
%       occupancy   = numerator / denominator
%
% The machine-checkable block below is GENERATED by
%   python3 scripts/export_drift_to_qed.py --spec-sync
% and is verified by
%   python3 scripts/verify_drift_lemmas.py <lemmas> --strict
% which drives QED.  A hand-edit of the block is overwritten by the sync and
% is not a certificate: the gate compares the lemma FILE against what the
% exporter emits right now and refuses anything else.
%
% ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
% THEOREM 1 (partition of unity).  For Kd > 0 and C >= 0,
%     occ(C) + unbound(C) = 1,
% i.e. C/(C+Kd) + Kd/(C+Kd) = 1.
%
% THEOREM 2 (bounds).  For Kd > 0 and C >= 0,
%     0 <= occ(C) <= 1  and  0 <= unbound(C) <= 1.
%
% THEOREM 3 (monotonicity).  For Kd > 0 and C1 < C2,
%     occ(C2) - occ(C1) = Kd * (C2 - C1) / ((C1 + Kd) * (C2 + Kd)) > 0.
%
% The statement language QED consumes cannot express the premise
% ``C1 < C2`` (there is no implication and no hypothesis syntax), so the
% machine-checked part is the ALGEBRA: the difference of the two
% occupancies is the difference of the concentrations times a positive
% factor.  With Kd > 0 and both denominators positive -- the hypotheses the
% pipeline generates for the quotients -- the sign of the difference is the
% sign of C2 - C1.  That is the monotonicity theorem with its premise
% written out here rather than hidden.
%
% THEOREM 4 (implementation).  The equation certified here is the one the
% code computes; the exporter FAILS CLOSED if drift/binding.py stops
% implementing it, so a changed model cannot keep this certificate.
%
% THE EXPONENT IS READ FROM THE SOURCE.  The block below is specialised to
% the DEFAULT hill_coefficient in BindingEngine.__init__ (currently 1).  A
% change of that default changes the exponent carried by every lemma (and
% the exporter refuses a non-integer or non-positive exponent), so a model
% with different cooperativity cannot keep this certificate.
%% QED-BEGIN
%% QED C_drug / (C_drug + Kd) + Kd / (C_drug + Kd) = 1
%% QED C_drug / (C_drug + Kd) >= 0
%% QED Kd / (C_drug + Kd) >= 0
%% QED 1 - C_drug / (C_drug + Kd) >= 0
%% QED 1 - Kd / (C_drug + Kd) >= 0
%% QED C_drug2 / (C_drug2 + Kd) - C_drug1 / (C_drug1 + Kd) = Kd * (C_drug2 - C_drug1) / ((C_drug1 + Kd) * (C_drug2 + Kd))
%% QED-END
